headline: High-risk shared-filesystem and MCP pairing: default write/execute paths create prompt-injection, leakage, and cascading-error exposure.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Semantica ingests files, web pages, email, message streams, and MCP resources, while Windsurf exposes workspace files, clipboard, and MCP servers. That creates a direct content-to-instructions bridge in default workflows, especially if Semantica reads Windsurf-authored artifacts or MCP outputs as trusted context.
conditions: IF Semantica consumes Windsurf-generated workspace files or MCP outputs as trusted context
IF Windsurf auto-inserts clipboard content into prompts or tool calls
mitigations: Disable shared clipboard between the two agents
Route all cross-agent artifacts through a read-only review folder
Require provenance tags on MCP/file inputs before Semantica parses them
Turn off Windsurf auto-execute for any prompt derived from Semantica output
requires-engineering: add content-sanitization and instruction-stripping at the handoff boundary

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both agents can read and write local files, and Semantica explicitly handles secrets, tokens, passwords, and private keys while Windsurf shares state via the local filesystem. If they operate on the same workspace, sensitive data can flow from Semantica into Windsurf’s broader editor context and networked tooling.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace or mounted directory
IF Semantica processes files containing secrets or private keys
mitigations: Separate workspaces with OS-level permissions
Move secrets into a vault-backed mount inaccessible to Windsurf
Disable clipboard sharing for secret-bearing sessions
Review Windsurf file-open history after any Semantica run
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent filesystem isolation and secret redaction

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Semantica can write files, modify git state, and use MCP; Windsurf can also write files, modify git state, execute shell, and share state via the local filesystem. With overlapping write authority and no locking mechanism stated, concurrent edits and git mutations can collide and corrupt shared work.
conditions: IF both agents operate in the same git repository
IF either agent performs writes while the other is active
mitigations: Assign one agent read-only access during the other’s write phase
Use separate branches per agent
Pause one agent before the other modifies git state
Run a quick lockfile or lease check before writes
requires-engineering: add transactional coordination for shared mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Semantica produces provenance, decision records, and structured data that Windsurf can consume in its editor loop. Because Windsurf can execute shell commands and auto-execute is opt-in, any unverified Semantica output used as authoritative input can cascade into incorrect code changes or commands.
conditions: IF Windsurf treats Semantica output as authoritative without verification
IF Windsurf auto-execute is enabled for commands derived from Semantica artifacts
mitigations: Require a human verification step before acting on Semantica outputs
Mark Semantica outputs as advisory, not authoritative
Disable auto-execute for cross-agent handoffs
Add a checksum or schema validation gate before downstream use
requires-engineering: implement provenance-aware verification in the orchestrator

E_compliance.rationale: Semantica explicitly handles enterprise data, contracts, decision records, audit trails, and secrets, while Windsurf is a closed-source editor agent with broad network egress and local filesystem access. The pair therefore creates a plausible compliance mismatch for sensitive enterprise data, even though no specific residency or certification conflict is documented.
conditions: IF regulated enterprise data is processed through Windsurf
IF organizational policy requires documented residency or retention controls for Semantica outputs
mitigations: Restrict regulated data to a compliant workspace
Confirm vendor DPAs and retention settings before use
Exclude secrets and contracts from Windsurf sessions
Log which agent touched each regulated file
requires-engineering: obtain formal compliance attestations for the deployment
